mission_2.prediction: I predict that BFS will finish sooner than DFS on the constrained map. This is because in Mission 1, BFS found the shorter path of 24.5 meters while DFS found a longer path of 104 meters. Even though DFS had a shorter planning time, I believe BFS's shorter route should make it reach the goal faster even with a slower planning time.
mission_2.performance: On the constrained map, BFS was able to complete it with an elapsed time of 90.452 seconds and distance of 23.9355 meters. DFS on the other hand timed out after 179.934 seconds and went 44.3126 meters without reaching the goal. These results supported my prediction that BFS would finish sooner than DFS. Looking at the graphs, BFS followed a direct route around the walls while DFS moved in a zigzag route making multiple turns and detours.
mission_2.choice: Personally, I would choose Nav2 as the delivery planner because it successfully reached the goal on both maps and had the fastest execution times in my trials. Nav2 was able to complete it on the contrained map in 73.084 seconds. Comparing this with PRM, Nav2 finished slightly faster. PRM took 75.532 seconds on the constrained map. Although PRM traveled a shorter distance, I would still prefer Nav2 because it did it faster. The advantage that matters most to me is successful and fast navigation. For a delivery robot, reaching the destination in less time is more important than traveling a slightly shorter distance.
